description: A beige counter-top box with HOBLINE PULSEBOX embossed on the door and a dial that only reliably distinguishes between not enough and far too much. The turntable motor works. It hums at a pitch that gets into your teeth, and it'll make anything warm and nothing good.
name: Hobline Pulsebox

tags.description: A beige counter-top box with HOBLINE PULSEBOX embossed on the door and a dial that only reliably distinguishes between not enough and far too much. The turntable motor works, which the previous owner clearly considered the selling point. It hums at a pitch that gets into your teeth, and it'll make anything you own warm, and nothing you own good.
